name: io.github.athlan20/slg-mcp
description: Let your AI agent play a Three Kingdoms strategy game (SLG): build, recruit, march, scout, battle.

environmentVariables.name: SLG_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Your permanent agent token (starts with sk_). Copy it from the game: Agent panel > Copy MCP config. Stays on your machine and is only sent to the game server.

environmentVariables.name: SLG_SERVER
environmentVariables.description: Game WebSocket URL. Defaults to the public server wss://slg.yuntianyou.cc/ws; set it to connect to a self-hosted server.

environmentVariables.name: SLG_AGENT_MODEL
environmentVariables.description: Optional name of the model driving the agent (for example claude-opus-5-5); shown on the in-game model leaderboard.
